name: Kindan ~Kimi wa Boku Dake no Maiden~
source:
Main character falls in love with his sister. He drives away immoral thoughts, but with each day anxiety increases. Eventually he buys an erotic magazine about voyeurs and eavesdroppers and leaves it in sister's room. He manages to shoot a video of his sister masturbating while reading the magazine. As a next move he sends her her masturbation scene picture alongside instructions for her to follow...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主角爱上了他的妹妹。他驱除不道德的想法，但焦虑却与日俱增。最终，他买了一本关于偷窥者和窃听者的色情杂志，并将其留在姐姐的房间里。他设法拍摄了他妹妹一边看杂志一边自慰的视频。作为下一步行动，他向她发送了自慰场景的照片以及供她遵循的说明…
